title: Harborview Tidal Pilot: project overview (synthetic fixture)
text: The Harborview Tidal Pilot is a demonstration tidal energy project in the fictional Harborview Strait. Construction began in 2019 and the pilot started delivering power to the regional grid in 2021. The pilot uses six horizontal-axis turbines mounted on the seabed. The installed capacity of the Harborview Tidal Pilot is 12 megawatts. The project was developed by the Strait Energy Consortium. Some observers suggest the pilot may be expanded into a second phase.
